spec.name: Furniture Grandfather Clock
spec.description: A tall mahogany grandfather clock with a stepped cornice, recessed pendulum cabinet, warm ivory pixel dial and brass pendulum. Connected, axis-aligned furniture within the requested bounds; front faces negative Z. Seventeen editable cuboids use distinct, non-overlapping cube nets.

elements.name: Ivory dial with painted brass bezel

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: tall mahogany grandfather clock with brass pendulum and readable pixel clock face. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
